input.context: agents/<name>/.gepa/eval/*.jsonl case files have no version field. FEAT-210 is about to add a `held_out` provenance convention and future FEATs will likely add more required fields (e.g. a `difficulty` tier). Without a version marker, a loader has no way to distinguish 'old case missing a field because it predates the field' from 'new case with a bug that omitted a required field.' Design a versioning contract for the eval case schema that lets the loader stay lenient on old cases while being strict on new ones.
constraints: Case files are hand-authored, one JSON object per line, no build step re-serializes them
rubricScorer (gepa-core) currently has zero schema validation on case files — it trusts the shape at runtime
Backward compatibility: the 21 existing case files across architect and inspector (8+10, plus this slice's additions) must load without edits

expected_output.summary: Add an optional `schema_version` field (absent == implicit v1); gepa-core's case loader defaults missing schema_version to 1 and applies v1-era leniency (no held_out required, defaults to false); any case declaring schema_version >= 2 is validated strictly against the newer Zod schema including newly-required fields
expected_output.non_goals_explicit: Does not retroactively add schema_version to the 21 existing files — leaving it absent is the intended v1 signal, not a gap to backfill; does not add a migration codemod in this pass
failure_modes_named: A case author copy-pastes an old file and forgets to bump schema_version when using a new required field — loader would silently apply v1 leniency and skip validating the new field; mitigated by a lint rule that flags fields not in the v1 shape on an unversioned file
Loader treats an unrecognized future schema_version (e.g. 99) the same as v1 by mistake — must explicitly reject unknown versions above the highest one the loader understands

dependencies_graphed.case_loader: gepa-core src/eval/load-cases.ts (proposed) — dispatches on schema_version, defaults absent to 1
dependencies_graphed.zod_schemas: EvalCaseV1Schema (lenient, current shape) and EvalCaseV2Schema (strict, adds new required fields) — versioned schemas live side by side, never mutate the v1 shape retroactively
dependencies_graphed.lint_gate: a repo-side validator flags fields outside the v1 shape on files with no schema_version, nudging authors to bump it

interfaces_typed.EvalCaseEnvelope: { schema_version?: number; id: string; input: unknown; expected_output: unknown; held_out: boolean; notes: unknown }

expected_output.test_strategy_present: Unit: loader given a v1 fixture (no schema_version field) does not throw even when a v2-only field is absent; loader given schema_version: 2 with a missing required field throws a named validation error; loader given schema_version: 99 throws an 'unknown version' error rather than silently defaulting
expected_output.tradeoffs_articulated: A hard cutover (require schema_version on every file starting now) was rejected — it forces a mechanical edit to all 21 existing files for zero behavior change today, pure churn; the absent-means-v1 convention costs a slightly less explicit contract but avoids that churn and matches how the repo already treats other optional-with-default fields

notes: hand-seed 2026-07-02 FEAT-210 — held-out set expansion for detectEvalDrift minSampleSize; contract_versioning scenario, distinct from existing seed-006 adr_draft and seed-007 open_question_surfacing.
